summary: M5.S4.2 Virtual Staging Sprint 2 tested end-to-end. Backend: 18/18 baseline pytest tests pass (styles catalog with modes+reverse, validation 400/401/422/404, history shape, save-to-property 404, unit helpers, backward-compat, watermark, photo caption). Frontend: full UI flow verified — /it/app/staging renders correctly, upload reveals step-2 controls with all 5 mode/variant testids, 5 style + 6 room pills, multi-style click auto-selects 4 styles. Property form staging modal: uploading a photo enables photo-stage-{idx} button, clicking opens staging-modal with staging-source-preview, photo auto-uploads to fal.ai (✓ 'Foto pronta per il rendering'), CRM-aware banner shows when linked to property, modal closes correctly. The single LIVE FAL generation could NOT complete: FAL account balance is exhausted ('User is locked. Reason: Exhausted balance'). Pipeline error handling works correctly (SAM2 stage marked failed, job marked failed with error message).

minor.issue: FAL_KEY account balance exhausted despite review request saying 'active, topped up'. Blocked the ONE live e2e test (download/dataurl/save-to-property). Pipeline itself handled the error gracefully.

issues: React warning: `value` prop on input should not be null (non-blocking, cosmetic console warning)

action_items: Top up FAL.AI balance to re-run the ONE live e2e test (test_m5s4_2_live.py with RUN_STAGING_LIVE=1). Estimated cost ~$0.11 for the num_variants=2 same_style standard job.
Fix minor React warning: 'value prop on input should not be null' in PropertyFormPage — use '' instead of null for controlled inputs.
critical_code_review_comments: virtual_staging.py (751 lines) approaching the recommended 700-line threshold — consider splitting stages (SAM2/Flux/Upscale) into a separate pipeline.py module.
SaveToProperty enforces agency_id but the query for the properties collection then removes it in the second lookup — verify agency_id ACL is consistent (line 715-720).

In _run_pipeline stage 3 upscale, up_cost is charged only for successful upscales — good. But if ALL upscales fail, upscale stage is marked 'failed' yet the overall job still transitions to 'done'. Consider: should partial-upscale failure be surfaced to user?
CRM-aware Gemini call uses gemini-3-flash-preview — verify this is the correct/current model name.

success_rate.backend: 100% (18/18 non-live) — live blocked by FAL balance
